name: DashGaussian
definition: A scheduling scheme over the optimization complexity of 3DGS that strips redundant complexity to accelerate optimization by progressively fitting Gaussians to higher frequency components and synchronizing primitive growth with rendering resolution.
summary: DashGaussian is a scheduling scheme for 3D Gaussian Splatting that accelerates optimization by synchronizing primitive growth with increasing resolution to fit high-frequency details after low-frequency structures are established.
